summary: 'My name is' in ASL is just two signs, MY and NAME, followed by your fingerspelled name. There's no sign for 'is.'
steps: Sign MY: a flat hand placed on your chest.
Sign NAME: two H handshapes, the dominant one tapping twice on top of the other.
Fingerspell your name at a steady rhythm, mouthing the whole name once rather than each letter.
note: Keep your fingerspelling hand still and at shoulder height. The whole phrase should flow: MY, NAME, spell, with no pause between MY and NAME.
mistakes: Adding a sign for 'is.' ASL doesn't have one here.
Dropping your hand between NAME and the fingerspelling. Keep it up and move straight into the letters.

faq.q: What if someone asks for my name sign?
faq.a: If you don't have one, shake your head and sign NO or NOT-YET. Name signs are given by Deaf people, usually after they know you.
